seo.title: Services
seo.description: Tailor-made journeys, Hotel + Flight + Tour packages, flight ticketing, group travel and travel insurance. Francorosso travel agency, Lugano.

hero.title: Everything an agency is actually worth having for.
hero.lede: Some things are better booked alone. Others are not: when a journey has more moving parts, more people or more risk, having someone who answers changes the day.

items.title: Tailor-made journeys
items.body: The centre of our work. We start with a conversation and end with a written itinerary: flights, hotels, transfers, visits, and the quiet hours in between. You review every version until it is your trip.
bullets: Hotels chosen by what they are like, not by star count
Local guides and drivers we know by name
A complete travel document before you leave

items.title: Hotel + Flight + Tour
items.body: The format we recommend most often: the structure of a package, with the choices you would have made inside it. We combine flight, stay and excursions, keeping the price under control and the freedom intact.
bullets: Option to extend or bring forward the stay
One clear price, with no hidden supplements

items.title: Flight ticketing
items.body: We issue tickets on every airline, including negotiated fares you will not find online. But the real reason to come to us is the day the flight collapses: changes, reissues and refunds are ours to handle.
bullets: Changes and reissues handled by the agency

items.title: Group travel
items.body: Our own escorted departures, and private groups built for associations, clubs, parishes and extended families. We take on the dull part too: registrations, deposits, rooming lists.
bullets: Fixed-date departures with a tour leader

items.title: Travel insurance
items.body: Cancellation, medical expenses, baggage, medical repatriation. We arrange it remotely in a few minutes, even if you booked the trip somewhere else.
bullets: Also available on bookings made online
Confirmed by email, without visiting the office

items.title: Business & MICE
items.body: Meetings, conventions, incentives, events and recurring business travel, with a single contact and reporting your finance office can read at a glance.
bullets: One contact for the whole trip

cta.title: You do not need a firm plan to write to us
cta.body: A vague request is enough: we ask two questions and send back something concrete.
